# commands

Slash commands for the main loop. The human gives them to the [coordinator](../agents/coordinator.md), which runs each phase's producer and adversarial reviewer on its own. Generated by `scripts/build-agents.py` from [data/skill-principle-map.json](../data/skill-principle-map.json).

| Command | Phases | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [/plan](plan.md) | Plan | Turn the brief into a spec and a plan with verifiable goals. |
| [/design](design.md) | Design | Design the modules, contracts and decisions the plan needs. |
| [/build](build.md) | Build | Implement the plan in small, safe steps that keep the build green. |
| [/verify](verify.md) | Verify, Debug | Prove the build works with tests and evidence, and find the root cause of what fails. |
| [/review](review.md) | Secure, Review & ship | Review the change for security and quality before it ships. |
| [/ship](ship.md) | Review & ship | Get the reviewed change merged and released through the gates. |
| [/retro](retro.md) | Learn | Turn the human's end-of-cycle feedback into proposed skill and check edits. |

The Harness skills have no command: the coordinator loads them, and starts the Harness producer and reviewer at the start of a run, to set up or check the project's agent harness, and when approved Learn edits are applied.
